_comment: NativeLink cache endpoint profiles (DATA, not engine policy). Each profile binds the Buck2 RE address, direct socket address, and REAPI instance name to one reviewed value set. Pinned grammar is grpc:// plus a DNS-LDH host (no IPv6 or trailing dot) and a canonical nonzero decimal u16 port; the socket form omits only the grpc:// prefix. Hand-maintained consumers — the infra/ci/buckconfig/warm-cache-{ro,rw}.buckconfig overlays and the storage/adapters/nativelink/nativelink-cas.k8s.yaml Service/NetworkPolicy bindings — must agree with the active profile; the ci/facade/build-cache-policy gate crate that enforced this contract was retired on dev (#1960), so agreement is enforced by review. Credentials and certificate material never belong here.
